<p class="mm-soon-banner"><span class="mm-chip">soon</span> This appendix is planned and not yet written.</p>

## What it will cover

- git for scientists: commits, branches, what to commit and what to ignore
- Environments: conda/mamba, uv, lock files, and recording versions
- Project layout: data/, notebooks/, src/, tests/, results/
- Seeds, logging and recording the exact inputs of every result
- Turning a notebook into a script and a script into a package
- Sharing: README, licence, citation, and a one-command rebuild

## Planned learning outcomes

1. Keep a project under version control and explain every commit.
2. Reproduce a result from a clean clone with one command.
3. Package a small analysis so that a colleague can run and extend it.

Until then, the reproducibility checklist in [episode 2.6](../part-1-foundations/ch02-ml-fundamentals/06-pipelines-leakage.html) and the [Setup](../part-1-foundations/ch00-start-here/02-setup.html) episode cover the essentials.
